source: Call of Duty Wiki — Killstreak (Call of Duty: Black Ops section)
note: All killstreaks are available for purchase at rank 10. Kills earned by a killstreak do not count towards the next one — every kill in the chain has to be yours.

profiles.name: Default
profiles.note: Spy Plane keeps information flowing early, Napalm punishes a held area, and Dogs closes a game out. A balanced spread that pays something out most games.

profiles.name: Support (3/4/5)
profiles.note: Low, reliable, and information-led. You will earn all three most games, and Spy Plane into Counter-Spy Plane is the single best thing you can do for a team that keeps getting flanked.

profiles.name: Assault (8/9/11)
profiles.note: High ceiling, high variance. Needs eight kills in a life before anything pays out — take Hardline or expect to collect nothing on a bad night.

killstreaks.name: Spy Plane
killstreaks.effect: Enemy positions on the minimap, refreshing every 3–4 seconds for 45 seconds. Can be shot down. Does not detect Ghost users.
killstreaks.tdm: The best value in the game at any cost. Information wins TDM more reliably than damage.

killstreaks.name: RC-XD
killstreaks.effect: Remote-controlled car with explosives. 30 seconds before it self-destructs.
killstreaks.tdm: Fun, and a free kill on a camped position — but you're stationary and helpless while driving it.

killstreaks.name: Counter-Spy Plane
killstreaks.effect: Jams enemy radar. Can be shot down.
killstreaks.tdm: Badly underrated. Blinding the enemy is worth more than seeing them when your team is losing map control.

killstreaks.name: SAM Turret
killstreaks.effect: Airdropped turret that targets all aerial killstreaks, infinite ammo.
killstreaks.tdm: Only if the lobby is running helicopters at you every game.

killstreaks.name: Care Package
killstreaks.effect: Airdrops a random killstreak, ammo, a Death Machine or a Grim Reaper. Re-rollable with Hardline Pro, trappable with Hacker Pro.
killstreaks.tdm: A lottery ticket that also doubles as bait — enemies walk to the smoke, and you can be watching it.

killstreaks.name: Napalm Strike
killstreaks.effect: Drops napalm on a designated area, leaving lingering fire.
killstreaks.tdm: Excellent on maps with a single obvious chokepoint or a spawn you can pin. The lingering burn denies ground long after the kills stop.

killstreaks.name: Sentry Gun
killstreaks.effect: Airdropped placeable turret. Destroyed by any damage, and by a single stab.
killstreaks.tdm: Good for locking a flank you can't watch yourself. Place it facing the route you keep dying to.

killstreaks.name: Mortar Team
killstreaks.tdm: Blind damage. Best used on the enemy spawn immediately after a spawn flip.

killstreaks.name: Attack Helicopter
killstreaks.effect: An AH-1 Cobra with flares. Cannot be controlled.
killstreaks.tdm: Fire and forget. Modest, but it costs you nothing to run and nothing to use.

killstreaks.name: Valkyrie Rockets
killstreaks.effect: Two controllable missiles. Can shoot down other killstreaks.
killstreaks.tdm: Skill-rewarding but you're stationary and exposed for the duration.

killstreaks.name: Blackbird
killstreaks.effect: Shows enemies AND the direction they are facing. Cannot be shot down. Ghost does not hide you from it.
killstreaks.tdm: The most decisive killstreak in the game. Direction-of-facing is what turns a flank from a guess into a certainty — and it's the one thing Ghost can't protect the enemy from.

killstreaks.name: Rolling Thunder
killstreaks.effect: A B-52 carpet-bombs an ordered area.
killstreaks.tdm: Wide, dumb damage. Strong on maps where the enemy funnels into one half.

killstreaks.name: Chopper Gunner
killstreaks.effect: Door gunner on a Huey circling the map. Enemies highlighted. One set of flares.
killstreaks.tdm: Big score swing, but you're a sitting duck on the ground the whole time it's up.

killstreaks.name: Attack Dogs
killstreaks.effect: A pack of dogs that hunt enemies and kill in one hit. Replacements arrive for dogs killed.
killstreaks.tdm: The best 11 in the game, and unlike the Gunship you keep playing while it works. Wins close games outright.

killstreaks.name: Gunship
killstreaks.effect: Pilot a Mi-24 Hind with rockets and a 12mm nose cannon.
killstreaks.tdm: Devastating when you get it. You will rarely get it.
